meta.name: digital-avatar-shopping-video
meta.description: 电商运营与自媒体创作者在需要制作商品推荐或促销带货短视频时，使用此技能可一键生成“小省导购员”数字人口播视频。系统自动协同五大智能体完成脚本、画面与音画合成，产出适配抖音、快手等平台的成品，高效搞定带货视频制作。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入商品信息，自动产出数字人带货短视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你做电商或自媒体，需要快速生成商品推荐视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn product info into ready-to-post avatar shopping videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you create product promo videos regularly for e-commerce or social media

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按五步依次做需求对接、脚本创作、数字人口播、画面设计与音画合成，产出 9:16 竖屏 MP4 带货视频，并把脚本、音频、画面、成品归档到知识库供同类需求复用。
howto.when: 当你要求生成带货视频、产品推荐视频、价格对比视频等时触发，技能按「小省导购员」的五智能体流程执行。

say.text: 推荐3款2000-3000元的性价比手机，做一条60秒带货视频
say.note: 先核查知识库，再出脚本、口播与成品

say.text: 对比京东和淘宝的Nike男鞋价格，做一条45秒对比视频
say.note: 画面用分屏呈现两平台价格与售后

say.text: 618大促推荐爆款家电，做一条90秒促销视频，面向家庭用户
say.note: 含限时降价与秒杀画面元素

howto.what_en: After install, Claude runs five agents in order: demand intake, script writing, digital-avatar voiceover, visual design, and audio-video compositing, producing a 9:16 MP4 shopping video and archiving assets to the knowledge base.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a shopping, product-recommendation, or price-comparison video; the skill then runs the five-agent guide flow.

say_en.text: Recommend 3 phones priced 2000-3000 yuan as a 60-second shopping video
say_en.note: Checks the knowledge base first, then makes the video

say_en.text: Compare Nike men's shoe prices on JD and Taobao in a 45-second video
say_en.note: Uses a split-screen with prices and after-sales

say_en.text: Make a 90-second 618 home-appliance promo video for families
say_en.note: Includes limited-time price cuts and flash-sale scenes
